t: When the news of the death of(Malik) al-Ashtar (may Allah have mercy on him), reached Amir al-Mu'minin, peace be upon him, he said : Malik, what a man Malik was!
By Allah, if he had been a mountain he would have been a big one (find) and if he had been a stone he would have been hard; no horseman could have reached it and no bird could have flown over it.
Al-Sayyid al-Radi says : "find" means a lonely mountain (rising in height above the range).
